topic: How to Deep Clean a Refrigerator
notes: Prioritize food safety and appliance-manufacturer compatibility. Wipe spills promptly, use hot soapy water for food-contact interior surfaces where appropriate, rinse, and avoid solvent cleaners, abrasives, or products that may impart chemical odors/tastes. Do not advise mixing cleaners. Keep instructions general enough to defer to the refrigerator manual for removable parts, finishes and electrical safety.
